text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Opening crash scenario and clear stance","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"It states a position immediately and builds the essay around defending that position rather than drifting into a general discussion."},{"evidence":"Multiple concrete downsides: laziness, more accidents, legal liability","quality":"support development","description":"It develops its claim with several distinct reasons that connect back to the prompt and to the source article."},{"evidence":"Explains why driverless cars could be unsafe in practice","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"It does more than list concerns by showing how the technology could lead to crashes, confusion, and responsibility disputes."},{"evidence":"Uses article lines about driver attention and fault","quality":"source integration","description":"It brings in evidence from the article and explains how those details support the argument."},{"evidence":"Clear intro, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It has a more coherent essay structure that makes the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"Restates position in the closing paragraph","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends by summarizing the main claims and reinforcing the final judgment in a direct way."}]}
